# @minigraf/browser 2.0.4

`minigraf_wasm.js` and `minigraf_wasm_bg.wasm` are copied unchanged from the npm package
[`@minigraf/browser@2.0.4`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@minigraf/browser/v/2.0.4)
(MIT OR Apache-2.0). Its version must read the format `docs.graph` is written in: the builder
pins `minigraf = "=2.0.4"` in Cargo.toml. Upgrade both together.

```sh
npm pack @minigraf/browser@2.0.4 && tar xzf minigraf-browser-2.0.4.tgz
cp package/minigraf_wasm.js package/minigraf_wasm_bg.wasm assets/vendor/minigraf-browser/
```
